## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Cameras
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Cameras and projections
//  - ICamera optics and output regions

//==
// # Cameras and projections
//
// Cameras place an eye in the scene and define how 3D points project onto the
// image plane. The view direction is the pose's forward axis. Clip distances
// (Near, Far) and other scene-space distances are unit-agnostic Numbers in
// scene units. Physically parameterized types (PhysicalCamera,
// DepthOfFieldSettings, StereoCameraRig) use Length (meters) and Duration
// (seconds), with photographic conventions (millimeter sensors, f-stops, ISO)
// noted per field.

// The projection family a camera uses; Panoramic is cylindrical.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/3D_projection)
type CameraProjection
    = Perspective | Orthographic | Fisheye | Equirectangular | Panoramic;

// A pinhole perspective camera defined by a vertical field of view.
// AspectRatio is image width over height; the horizontal field of view follows
// from VerticalFov and AspectRatio.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pinhole_camera_model and
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perspective_projection.
type PerspectiveCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    VerticalFov: Angle;
    AspectRatio: Number;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// A parallel-projection camera. OrthoHeight is the vertical extent of the view
// volume in scene units; the width is OrthoHeight times AspectRatio.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orthographic_projection)
type OrthographicCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    OrthoHeight: Number;
    AspectRatio: Number;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// A camera parameterized like a real photographic body and lens. FocalLength
// and FocusDistance are physical lengths (a 50mm lens is 0.05 meters);
// SensorSize is in millimeters by photographic convention; FStop is the
// aperture number N in f/N (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F-number); Iso is
// ISO 12232 sensitivity; ShutterTime is the exposure duration. IField of view
// follows from FocalLength and SensorSize; exposure follows from FStop,
// ShutterTime, and Iso.
type PhysicalCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    FocalLength: Length;
    SensorSize: Size2D;
    FStop: Number;
    FocusDistance: Length;
    Iso: Number;
    ShutterTime: Duration;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// The radial mapping of a fisheye lens: how the angle from the optical axis
// maps to distance from the image center. Stereographic is the same projection
// used on the sphere (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stereographic_projection).
type FisheyeMapping = Equidistant | EquisolidAngle | Orthographic | Stereographic;

// A wide-angle camera with a fisheye radial mapping (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisheye_lens).
// FieldOfView is the full cone angle covered by the image circle; some mappings
// support a full hemisphere or more.
type FisheyeCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    Mapping: FisheyeMapping;
    FieldOfView: Angle;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// A spherical panorama camera mapping longitude to X and latitude to Y
// (equirectangular / lat-long; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Equirectangular_projection).
// Sweeps of 360 by 180 degrees capture the whole sphere; smaller sweeps crop it.
type EquirectangularCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    LongitudeSweep: AngleInterval;
    LatitudeSweep: AngleInterval;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// A cylindrical panorama camera (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panorama).
// HorizontalSweep is the arc covered around the pose's vertical axis;
// VerticalFov is the perspective field of view across the cylinder height.
type PanoramicCamera
    implements ICamera
{
    Pose: Pose3D;
    HorizontalSweep: Angle;
    VerticalFov: Angle;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// A perspective camera authored by aiming: positioned at Position, looking at
// Target, with Up resolving the roll about the view axis.
type LookAtCamera
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Target: Point3D;
    Up: Direction3D;
    VerticalFov: Angle;
    AspectRatio: Number;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}

// The world-space projection rectangle for off-axis projection, given by three
// of its corners; the fourth follows by parallelogram completion. The plane
// need not be perpendicular to the view direction.
type ProjectionPlane
    implements IValue
{
    LowerLeft: Point3D;
    LowerRight: Point3D;
    UpperLeft: Point3D;
}

// An asymmetric-frustum (off-axis) camera: an eye point plus an arbitrary
// projection rectangle in world space. Serves head-tracked displays, CAVEs,
// portals, and tiled display walls.
type OffAxisCamera
    implements IValue
{
    Eye: Point3D;
    Screen: ProjectionPlane;
    Near: Number;
    Far: Number;
}
```
